sceneFacts.shortVersion: Cooper based his chef role on real culinary stars.
sceneFacts.longDescription: To prepare for his role as chef Adam Jones, Bradley Cooper based his character on Gordon Ramsay and two other celebrity chefs. He incorporated physical characteristics and "little things" from these three chefs into his performance. Consultant chef Marcus Wareing also helped teach the core actors to cook and act like chefs for the film.

sceneFacts.shortVersion: Actors learned to fillet fish and shuck oysters for real.
sceneFacts.longDescription: To ensure authenticity, the actors underwent extensive training to handle seafood. Sienna Miller, who plays Helene, eagerly learned to fillet fish, including turbot, a skill she found exciting. Consultant chef Marcus Wareing noted that the film's opening even featured Adam Jones shucking oysters. All food preparation scenes were performed for real, with genuine chefs acting as extras.

sceneFacts.shortVersion: Real chefs worked in the film's fully functional kitchen set.
sceneFacts.longDescription: To create an authentic restaurant environment, the production built a fully functional kitchen set. Real chefs from Michelin-starred restaurants were hired as extras, performing actual food preparation. Consultant chef Marcus Wareing even had the stoves turned on full to add to the realism.

sceneFacts.shortVersion: Adam Jones's birthday cake scene was called "sickly sweet."
sceneFacts.longDescription: Adam Jones's gesture of bringing a specially made birthday cake to a little girl was described by one reviewer as a "sickly sweet" and "twee" moment. The scene was considered "sappy" due to its direction, writing, and acting, and featured the "unfortunate trope of having a very precocious child."

sceneFacts.shortVersion: Burnt filmed scenes in London and New Orleans.
sceneFacts.longDescription: The film Burnt was shot in several real-world locations. Specific filming sites in London included The Langham Hotel, Blythe House, and Al Enam Restaurant. Additional scenes for the movie were also filmed in New Orleans.
